text: Quel'Serrar is an ancient blade, forged by night elves and five dragonflights long ago and gifted to the kaldorei. Its twin, Quel'Delar, was similarly gifted to the quel'dorei. For thousands of years, Quel'Serrar has been kept in the care of the Shen'dralar Ancients, waiting for one capable of restoring the blade. The blade is now rumored to be borne by a new master. Although dated, it is rather rare to see an "original" Quel'Serrar, and is considered a testament to Classic Raiding.

Qiraji Martial Drape is a Cenarion Circle armor token. It can be exchanged along with various idols and scarabs at various NPCs at Cenarion Hold for the following items: * Drape of Unyielding Strength * Cloak of Veiled Shadows * Shroud of Infinite Wisdom * Drape of Vaulted Secrets

Raven's Wood is a forested area in the northwestern area of the Blade's Edge Mountains. It is the location of Grishnath, Boulder'mok, and Blackwing Coven, and it is roamed by agressive ancients and neutral ravens.

Razaan's Landing is a camp of ethereals led by Nexus-Prince Razaan located in Bladed Gulch in eastern Blade's Edge Mountains. It is full of floating balls which are made up of equal parts mana and soul matter. Fleshbeasts crawl the ground and the ethereals attack anyone on sight.

__NOTOC__ Raven's Wood Leafbeards are Draenor ancients found in Raven's Wood in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Razaani Spell-Thieves are ethereals found at Razaan's Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Razak's Roughriders is a group of gnomes mounted on mechanostriders in Blade's Edge Mountains and Kul Tiras. They are led by Razak Ironsides. When Toshley's Station is under attack by ravagers, they are called in to defend the town, by Razak. They also help defend the town of Rustbolt.

Rawr is a stand-alone program (and soon to be Web App) for comparing and exploring gear for Bears, Cats, Moonkin, Healadins, Retadins, Mages, DPS Warriors, Protection Warriors, Trees, Hunters, Protection Paladins, Healing Priests, Shadow Priests, Enhancement Shamans, Warlocks, Rogues, Restoration Shamans, Elementals, and DPS & Tank Death Knights. Rawr has been designed from the start to be fun to use and helpful for finding optimal gear combinations and what gear to obtain. It is currently strictly aimed at PVE, and takes the guess work out of deciding what gear to use, in what combination, when you should and should not drop set bonuses, etc. PVP modeling is not likely to appear due to the

The Razaani can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains. They're capturing souls in Razaani Light Orbs, some from Mok'Nathal ancestors, some from Gnomes. Nexus-Prince Razaan himself holds a Collection of Souls.

Razlo Crushcog is a leper gnome piloting a mechano-tank who can be found on the little island on Iceflow Lake in Chill Breeze Valley, Dun Morogh. He was sent by Sicco Thermaplugg to harass High Tinker Mekkatorque after the failure of Operation: Gnomeregan. With leper gnomes and crowd pummelers at his disposal, Crushcog planned to bolster his forces by repairing broken-down mechano-tanks in what is now known as Crushcog's Arsenal. However, Gnomeregan forces led by Jarvi Shadowstep continue to carry out missions against him. Ultimately Crushcog is confronted by Mekkatorque, and the combined forces of Gnomeregan and the Ironforge dwarves are able to defeat him.

Refurbished Steam Tank is a siege engine that can be found in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City. Soon after spawning it will begin moving slowly along the harbor path; before long, however, it explodes and falls apart. During the Scourge Invasion, it aided in the defense of Stormwind Harbor, attacking any Towering Horrors it came across before falling apart.

The Regenerating Barrier of the Depths can be purchased for 50 Prismatic Manapearl from the following vendors in Nazjatar after reaching with their respective faction: * Speaker Utia of the Waveblade Ankoan, found in Mezzamere * Atolia Seapearl of the Unshackled, found in Newhome Only classes with a tank specialization can purchase it. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 3 of the Aegis of the Deep Essence and leave behind a Crumbling Barrier.
The Relentless Scythe is a Level 55 quality Two-Handed Sword that improves Strength, Stamina and Critical Strike.
Rema is the den mother of the wolves found at Jagged Ridge in the Blade's Edge Mountains. She can usually be found at the cave entrance towards Zangarmarsh. She can only be tamed by Alliance hunters.
The Resistance Armor Vendor is a goblin located at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

__NOTOC__ Revenger is a one-handed sword ideal for warriors, death knights and rogues. The weapon proc currently counts the player's +spell power gear, seemingly on a 1:1 ratio. Revenger drops from Commander Sarannis in the Botanica wing of Tempest Keep on normal difficulty.

Rhok'delar, Longbow of the Ancient Keepers is the hunter quest bow. The quest involves defeating (solo, no pet or friends) four powerful demons and slaying the fearsome Onyxia. It is created when the Ancient Rune Etched Stave is used when in possession of a Enchanted Black Dragon Sinew.
Ridgespine Stalkers are giant spiders found in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Ridgespine Horrors are giant spiders found in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
The Ridge of Madness was a planned subzone in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Rhonin's Shield is a small Kirin Tor camp on the Upper Frostlands of eastern Azure Span. Nearby locations include Theron's Watch to the north, the Winterpelt Hollow to the northeast, Vakthros far to the east, and the Slyvern Plunge to the south. The flight master, Portia Striat, has connections to Theron's Watch, Cobalt Assembly, Camp Antonidas, and Camp Nowhere, all in the Azure Span.

Righteous Plates is an armor shop located in the Cathedral Square in Stormwind City. It is owned and run by dual-proprietors Agustus and Theresa Moulaine, and can be found just south of the Cathedral of Light. The shop sells a variety of items, including mail and plate armor, shields, and robes.
Rip-Blade Ravagers are ravagers found in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Rivendark's Perch is the lair of the black dragon Rivendark, who flies over the Vortex Pinnacle in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Rivendark is a black dragon that flies over the Vortex Pinnacle in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Be very careful around Rivendark — if he detects you he will spit a fireball at you. (~3000 damage) Rivendark can be called down at any time by opening Rivendark's Egg at Rivendark's Perch (requires 35 Apexis Shards. When summoned, he lands and attacks the party.
Riverside Staff drops from Murloc Tidecallers in the Redridge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Robes of Insight are cloth chest armor with intellect and spirit. It also has a unique ability that reduces the cost of your next spell cast within 10 sec by up to 500 mana.

The Rugged Dragonscale is a ship located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.

The SGM-3 is a powerful shoulder-mounted missile used to bring down Skybreaker Recon Fighters for the quest Blinding the Eyes in the Sky and its follow-up daily version, Keeping the Alliance Blind.

Sai'kkal the Elder is an arakkoa priest found at the Vortex Pinnacle in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Together with the Ancient Raven-Priest, they are part of a cult that worships the raven god Anzu. During the quest The Book of the Raven (quest), the character seeks Sai'kkal out to find out more about the Book of the Raven. He can only be seen while sight is augmented through the use of the Seer's Stone.

__NOTOC__ Samia Inkling is a black dragon quest giver located at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains. She serves Baron Sablemane; the human guise of the black dragon Sabellian. Along with her master, she traveled to the Dragon Isles. She is found as his quartermaster at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores. In her dragon form, Samia occasionally flies through Valdrakken.
Sambino's Air Balloon is one of the The Great Sambino's creations, the balloon has a capability to inflate and can become a carrier.

The Sanctum of the Prophets is a Twilight's Hammer outpost located directly north of Ascendant's Rise in Mount Hyjal. The Twilight's Hammer mad prophets congregate here. It is said their dark visions are granted to them directly by the Old Gods. It is also here one of Ragnaros' most powerful lieutenants, Azralon, serves as the sole gatekeeper to Sulfuron Spire. The flamegate to the Inner Spire can be found here.
Sassa Weldwell is a gnome trade goods vendor located at Toshley's Station in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Permanently enchant a two-handed weapon to add 35 attack power. As of patch 2.1 this enchant has a red glow that looks similar to dripping blood.

Savage Saronite Battlegear is a rare quality plate armor set based around Resilience and physical damage dealing. It is wholly crafted through the Blacksmithing tradeskill, requiring a minimum of 425 blacksmithing skill to create the entire set. The items of the set require a minimum level of 78 to equip, but have no other requirements (outside of being able to equip plate armor). The resiliance afforded by this armor makes it of most interest in Player vs Player (PvP) scenarios. It is also useful for tanks for its high Stamina and for helping to reach crit immunity. The relative availability of the materials required to craft the pieces make it good for fleshing out stats and gear pieces as

Scale Shield is a pet ability available exclusively to the Scalehide family of hunter pets, reducing pet damage taken by 50% for 12 sec.
Scalewing Shelf is an area of southeastern Blade's Edge Mountains that is home to many wind serpents and raptors.

The Scrap-O-Matic 1000 is a scrapper that allows weapons and armor of quality or higher to be broken down into base components such as Monelite Ore and Durable Flux. Searing Collars are worn by Burning Blade cultists, which burn their flesh. Margoz believes the collars attune the cultists with demonic powers. Later, Arnak Fireblade found out that the collars were one of the sources of demonic corruption in orc society. Sedai's Blade is an one-hand sword. It gives bonuses to stamina, intellect, and spell power. This is Vindicator Sedai's weapon.
Seraph's Strike is a two-handed sword that grants the wielder a boost to strength and spirit.

Seschenal is the staff wielded by the titan Eonar. This staff resembles a gigantic shepherd's crook. It is pure alabaster, shot through with thin red veins that resemble blood vessels — indeed, the lines pulse as if possessed of some magical heartbeat. The staff’s touch restores hope to the despairing, energy to the weary and life to the dead.

A server blade or just blade is a self-contained server on which each World of Warcraft realm runs. Multiple blades fit into an enclosure which provides the power, cooling, connectivity, and management to each blade. The blades themselves contain only the core processing elements, making them hot-swappable. HP refers to the entire package as a BladeSystem. By consolidating and housing multiple servers in a single enclosure, energy costs are significantly reduced, cabling is drastically reduced and managing servers is simplified. Blizzard has auctioned off retired blades in the past for charity, including a 15th Anniversary one for the BlizzCon 2019 charity auction.
The Shadow Crescent Axe is a Blacksmith-made two-handed axe that gives a bonus to strength and stamina.

Shadow Shield is a Voidwalker passive ability, learned at level 16.

Shadowbreak Ravine is a well-hidden haven for Burning Blade cultists found in the mountains southeast of Shok'Thokar in Desolace. It holds several structures including giant mushrooms and a summoning circle with giant chains. The Burning Blade and demon army, which has invaded Magram Village and pushed the centaur from the area, are commanded by Agogridon. They have begun burning the structures and renamed the area to Shok'Thokar. After the quest Death to Agogridon, the area will only have the corpses of Burning Blade cultists and demons.
Shaft of the Stars is created by combining Elaborate Disc and Sultan's Staff.
The Shard-Bound Bracers are a reputation reward; you must be Exalted with Ogri'la to purchase it for from in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Shan-Dun, Breaker of Hope is a battle spear infused with the power of lightning. It was used by Lei Shen, the Thunder King, during his reign as emperor. After his death it was lost in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. It was found by adventurers aligned with the Golden Lotus before being stolen by the forces of Zhao-Jin the Bloodletter and returned to the recently resurrected Thunder King. Lei Shen used the spear in the second and third phases of his final battle.

Shartuul is a man'ari eredar found in Shartuul's Transporter in the Blade's Edge Mountains. For more information on how to defeat him see Shartuul's Transporter (event). Killing Shartuul during the Shartuul Event awards you 750 Ogri'la reputation.

Enric did so on a day he could taste a storm on the air; the other captain got well ahead, pleased with his progress until his ship was struck by lightning and sank, burning.

Shield Block is a level 6 warrior defensive ability that blocks all attacks for 6 seconds. While in Protection spec, it also increases Shield Slam's damage by 30% and has 2 charges. It can only be used when the warrior has a shield equipped.

A shield is a type of armor carried in the off-hand equipment slot. A shield may also be referred to as an aegis or buckler. A shield contributes to the Armor and can prevent damage by blocking attacks. Warriors, Paladins, and Shamans are the only classes that may use shields. A shield cannot be used with weapons that require two hands to wield, as shields fill the off-hand slot. However, Warriors with Titan's Grip may use a 2-hander and a shield. Paladins and warriors have several abilities can only be used when a shield is equipped, such as Spell Reflection and Shield of the Righteous. Shields have far more armor than any other piece of equipment. A shield has roughly 60% as much armor as

Shield Mastery is a Warrior talent on Tier 2 of the Protection tree. It reduces the cooldown of Shield Block and Shield Wall, and causes Shield Block to reduce magic damage taken for 6 seconds.

A shield pack is a backpack with a limited carrying capacity due to the phlogiston bioler and mechanisms concealed in its interior. These mechanisms connect to large mechanical arm that reaches around the wearer and ends in a heavy wooden shield. When devices concealed behind the shield detect an incoming attack, the shield swings to block it. However, as the movement of the shield is automatic, it often gets in the way of the wearer's attacks as it protects her. When turned off, the shield arm folds away over the back of the pack.

Shield's Rest is an island off the northeastern coast of Stormheim. Many elite creatures are found here. Spears were an in-game weapon type during the development of World of Warcraft. The proficiency to use them could be learned by druids, hunters, and warriors. Dulciea Frostmoon was a spear trainer. The Spirit Fields are an area of southwestern Nagrand centered around the "holy mountain" of Oshu'gun. The Fields are inscribed with mystic symbols of unknown meaning or origin, and the plains are inhabited by wild elekks, herds of clefthooves and earth elementals. Durn the Hungerer, one of the sons of the gronn overlord Gruul the Dragonkiller, can be found wandering the Spirit Fields, and the queen of the elekk, Tusker, stands on a bluff facing Oshu'gun. This area was once the forested Spirit Woods.

It cannot be opened by any other means, and the keys that open other Ethereum Stasis Chambers do not work on it. When the Stasis Chamber Alpha is opened, it will spawn . This is a quest-mob with no notable loot other than the quest item . Opening the Stasis Chamber Alpha and completing the "Stasis Chambers of Bash'ir" quest opens up the repeatable quest, Purging the Chambers of Bash'ir, which involves opening an Ethereum Stasis Chamber.

Swords come in one-handed and two-handed edged weapon varieties, usually in the form of a long, narrow blade with a short handle or hilt. Some swords have one primary edge, some have broader blades, and even others have longer hilts, but all generally rely on the ability to slash an opponent with only occasional piercing attacks. One-handed weapons generate less damage per second and fewer bonuses than their two-handed counterparts of the same level. One- and two-handed Swords can be wielded by death knights, paladins, warriors and hunters. One-handed swords can also be wielded by mages, monks, rogues, warlocks and demon hunters.
